prose: Jason Quitt returns to InnerVerse to discuss research and insights from his brand new book, Astral Genesis. Jason is a teacher of energetic self-healing arts, the use of crystals, and revelatory perspectives on ancient astro-theological Egyptian (and other cultures) artifacts. His new book provides a fresh take on the as-above-so-below math (Ma'at) that human ancestors encoded in their megalithic works.
ext: Jason reveals more about the solar key and the cubit of measure, potentially uncovering an ancient "GPS" system for a universal maritime empire.
